args.prompt: Edit this image only: he has just finished a long drink. He lowers the glass to chest height; it is the same tall straight-sided plain clear glass (no stem, no ice), now only ONE-THIRD full of pale gold sparkling soda. His waxed moustache tips spring up a notch, one eyebrow raised, delighted, eyes amused; he stands at the very edge of the spire, weight on his front foot, ready to leap. Keep everything else exactly the same: the man, clothes, the AURUM can on the ledge, the sunset city, framing.
